title: Adaptive Pullback: Reweighting Supervision at Penalty Jumps in On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block

translated_title: 自适应回拉：在线策略蒸馏中惩罚跳变处的监督重加权
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过采样token的学生-教师对数比率来监督学生模型生成的回复。正的对数比率会惩罚学生赋予比教师更高概率的token，但其当前数值无法区分持续的高惩罚和沿回复方向的突然增加。我们通过比较同一回复内连续的token块来考察这些局部变化。我们的诊断方法识别出了“惩罚跳变”——即在保留token上持续存在的平均惩罚的突然增加。在这些跳变处，惩罚上升的同时教师置信度却下降。我们将这种模式称为“惩罚-置信度张力”。而进入高惩罚块的边界并未表现出可比的置信度变化，这表明局部变化提供了超出当前惩罚值之外的信息。受此观察启发，我们提出了自适应回拉OPD（AP-OPD）。在每个检测到的跳变处，AP-OPD利用前一块……
tldr: 该论文发现在线策略蒸馏中存在“惩罚-置信度张力”现象——惩罚跳变处惩罚上升而教师置信度下降，并据此提出AP-OPD方法，在每个检测到的跳变处对监督信号进行自适应重加权。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "penalty-confidence tension" in on-policy distillation, where penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases at penalty jumps, and proposes Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD), which adaptively reweights supervision at each detected jump.
